description: Wallonie - centres autorisés de tri, regroupement, valorisation et élimination des déchets is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SPW ARNE. Cette liste fait partie des jeux de données concernant les entreprises et installations de collecte, de recyclage et d'élimination de déchets agréés en Wallonie. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal lists 7 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are Déchets. The portal shows 10 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
